svg.title: FDG-PET: Fluorodeoxyglucose PET
svg.desc: FDG-PET (Fluorodeoxyglucose PET), acquisition cost 2.0 units. Measures brain glucose metabolism. Alzheimer's shows a pattern of reduced uptake. Incremental AUC over the cheap-only model at 12, 24 and 36 months: +0.039, +0.032, +0.058.
svg.text: AUC gain over the cheap-only model
